entity.description:
Phoenix III is a beachfront condo in Orange Beach offering direct beach access and Gulf-front views from private balconies. The property features fully furnished 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals that accommodate up to 10 guests, with floor-to-ceiling windows designed to highlight the Alabama Gulf Coast’s natural light and shoreline scenery.
